voice-branch-jargon.notes: [EXPIRED-NO-FIELD-HASH] Clean. "one algebraic skeleton and a single substrate parameter" uses "skeleton" as an ordinary mathematical metaphor, not as a stub/placeholder marker.

trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read; 'eliminating volume as an external assumption' and 'without empirical nuclear tuning' are substantive scope statements; no not-X-but-Y scaffolding.

trap-rhetorical-pivot.evidence: No setup-then-reframe constructions across 20 chapter summaries.

trap-em-dash.evidence: Five em-dash pairs, all genuine appositive lists (measured constants; three constraints; millennium problems; calibration inputs).

trap-triples.evidence: Triples are substantive: three cohomological constraints, three action terms (gravity/gauge/matter), three calibration DOF — each is the actual mathematical count.

trap-closing-aphorism.evidence: Final line ('Every other physical mass, binding energy, and coupling acts strictly as a zero-parameter prediction.') is a substantive framework claim, not a decorative quotable.

trap-thesis-restatement.evidence: 'That skeleton structurally anchors the framework.' (para 1) is mildly redundant but positional (opening framing, not a closer); the Calibration paragraph is new content.

trap-superlative.evidence: Pervasive intensifier saturation, ~30 sites: 'organically derives', 'effortlessly fixes/recovers' x2, 'rigorously recovers/limits/generate/constructing' x4, 'perfectly separates', 'firmly behaves', 'forcefully connects', 'correctly internalizes', 'natively' x3, 'systematically' x4, 'precisely' x4, 'strictly' x8, 'cleanly', 'identically' x2, 'comprehensively', 'dynamically'. Near-every verb carries a maximum-strength adverb — the classic density tell.
trap-superlative.notes: proposed (structural, whole block): strip decorative adverbs, keep load-bearing qualifiers ('exactly three', 'uniquely'). E.g. 'This fundamental triple organically derives...' -> 'This triple derives...'; 'The geometry effortlessly fixes...' -> 'The geometry fixes...'. Also flagged separately (not a trap category): 'predict... the exact proton and neutron masses' conflicts with the 2026-08-11 absolute-mass excision ruling, and 'q_0 approx 1.1097' mis-rounds q_0 approx 1.10998.

trap-nonspeakable.evidence: Dense but speakable; formula-anchored sentences parse aloud.
